source.content: public class FutureWorker { @future public static void mark() { insert new Account(Name = 'future'); } }

public class BatchWorker { public List<Integer> start(Object bc) { return new List<Integer>{1, 2}; } public void execute(Object bc, List<Integer> scope) { for (Integer value : scope) { insert new Account(Name = 'batch-' + value); } } public void finish(Object bc) { insert new Account(Name = 'batch-finish'); } }
public class ScheduledWorker { public void execute(Object sc) { insert new Account(Name = 'scheduled'); } }
public class FirstQueue { public void execute(Object qc) { insert new Account(Name = 'queue-1'); System.enqueueJob(new SecondQueue()); } }
public class SecondQueue { public void execute(Object qc) { insert new Account(Name = 'queue-2'); } }

@isTest private class AsyncFixtureTest { @isTest static void drainsAsync() { Test.startTest(); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getAsyncJobs()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getFutureCalls()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getQueueableJobs()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); FutureWorker.mark(); Database.executeBatch(new BatchWorker(), 1); System.schedule('nightly', '0 0 0 * * ?', new ScheduledWorker()); System.enqueueJob(new FirstQueue()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage email = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); email.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'hello@example.test'}); email.setPlainTextBody('hello'); Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{email}); System.assertEquals(4, Limits.getAsyncJobs()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getFutureCalls()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getQueueableJobs()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); Test.stopTest(); Integer rows = [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(6, rows); List<AsyncApexJob> jobs = [SELECT Id, Status FROM AsyncApexJob]; System.assertEquals(5, jobs.size()); List<CronTrigger> crons = [SELECT Id, State FROM CronTrigger]; System.assertEquals(1, crons.size()); } }
